# The client side of the Aion 4.8 protocol: login crypto (Blowfish, the SM_INIT handshake, the raw RSA of CM_LOGIN), game crypto and frames,
# the opcode tables (generated by tools/gen/opcodes.py), the CM_* packet builders and the SM_* decoders. It turns bytes into typed structs
# and back, nothing else: no sockets, threads, commons, OpenSSL or gtest, C++20 and the standard library only, so the UE client
# (Plugins/AionNet, which compiles src/ through a directory junction) and the scenario tests of this repository share it.
#
# Built as part of cpp/ (target aion_client_protocol, tests aion_client_protocol_tests) or on its own, which proves it has no other
# dependency:  cmake -S cpp/client-protocol -B build/client-protocol && cmake --build build/client-protocol
if(CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR)
	cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
	project(aion-client-protocol VERSION 4.8 LANGUAGES CXX)
	set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
endif()

file(GLOB_RECURSE cp_sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.h")
source_group(TREE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src" FILES ${cp_sources})
add_library(aion_client_protocol STATIC ${cp_sources})
target_include_directories(aion_client_protocol PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
# C++20 like UE 5.8's default CppStandard; consumers keep their own standard (the rest of cpp/ is C++23)
set_target_properties(aion_client_protocol PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 20 CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(TARGET aion::compiler_options)
	target_link_libraries(aion_client_protocol PUBLIC aion::compiler_options)
elseif(MSVC)
	target_compile_options(aion_client_protocol PRIVATE /W4 /permissive- /utf-8 /Zc:__cplusplus /EHsc)
else()
	target_compile_options(aion_client_protocol PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endif()

# The unit tests compare the library's RSA with OpenSSL's, so only they need OpenSSL (from the vcpkg of the cpp/ build)
if(COMMAND aion_add_tests)
	find_package(OpenSSL REQUIRED)
	aion_add_tests(aion_client_protocol_tests "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests" DEPENDS aion_client_protocol OpenSSL::Crypto)
endif()
